content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need urgent help. I'm having trouble uploading a program to the [product_name], but there's no error message and the device won't enter run mode—it stays off. I've done this many times before without issues. Here are my network settings: Device IP: 192.168.0.1, subnet mask: 255.255.255.0, gateway: 192.168.0.0; My PC IP: 192.168.0.2, subnet mask: 255.255.255.0. You can also see the picture in the attachment.

Are you connecting through a router? What is the router's IP address, and why did you specify a gateway address? Which [product_name] version do you have—[article_no] Standard or the newer [article_no] FS04?

Have you updated [product_name] software to [version_no]? This update is free. The latest hardware ([article_no] FS4) requires [product_name] [version_no]; you can't use it with the previous software version.
I want to connect directly via ethernet cable and am not using a router. How can I download [product_name] [version_no]? Could you please provide a download link?

You can get it from the [company_name] website under demo software, upgrades, updates, and drivers. Be sure to choose the correct operating system (32-bit or 64-bit). After downloading, run Setup.exe as administrator. Alternatively, you can upgrade within the [product_name] software itself—check out the topic on upgrading from one version to another.
Thank you to everyone—my issue is resolved.
Hello all, this is my first post on the forum. Thanks for the uploader solution for [product_name]; it helped me as well. Best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users had difficulty uploading programs to a [product_name], which remained in 'off' mode. The problem was due to software and hardware incompatibility, as newer device versions require updated software. Because no explicit error messages appeared, users were confused and lost time troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect program uploading to work smoothly and for error messages to be clear and informative when using [product_name] software with different hardware versions.
